integration_tests.name: Pi process spawns and streams
integration_tests.evidence: M3 validation: uv run pytest -q → 24 passed. IT-3 spawns pi, get_state returns success with sessionFile, send_prompt returns success, iter_events yields >1 text_delta through agent_settled, proc.state == 'idle' after.

integration_tests.name: Message endpoint streams to client
integration_tests.evidence: M4 validation: uv run pytest -q → 29 passed. IT-4: POST /messages returns text/event-stream, >1 text_delta parsed, 1 done event with message_id, GET /messages returns 2 messages (user + assistant).

integration_tests.name: History survives process death
integration_tests.evidence: M5 validation: uv run pytest -q → 31 passed. IT-5: sends 'PINEAPPLE-42', kills pi process (proc.is_alive == False), sends follow-up, pi reloads session via --session, reply contains 'pineapple'.

integration_tests.name: History survives backend restart
integration_tests.evidence: M5 validation: uv run pytest -q → 31 passed. IT-6: sends 'TURQUOISE' on app1, fully shuts down app1, creates app2 with same DB, GET messages returns 2 (persisted), sends follow-up, reply contains 'turquoise'.

integration_tests.name: Cross-tenant access refused on every endpoint
integration_tests.evidence: M7 validation: uv run pytest -q → 36 passed. 5 IT-7 tests: all return 404 with opaque body (no leaked fields). E2e test_e2e_full Phase 5: 20 opaque 404 checks (2 tenants × 2 conversations × 5 endpoints).

integration_tests.name: Client disconnect aborts pi
integration_tests.evidence: M4 validation: uv run pytest -q → 29 passed. IT-8: sends message, proc.is_streaming == False after client close, second message succeeds with done event (pi not stuck).

integration_tests.name: Two tenants stream concurrently
integration_tests.evidence: M8: make e2e → 1 passed in 13.83s. test_e2e_full sends messages for both tenant-a and tenant-b within the same app instance (both tenants' pi processes alive concurrently). All streaming exchanges verified incremental (>1 text_delta). Cross-tenant isolation proven by Phase 5 (20 opaque 404 checks, list isolation). Note: messages sent sequentially, not truly simultaneously — concurrent process management and data isolation verified, not wire-level parallelism.

integration_tests.name: Pi has no tools
integration_tests.evidence: M3 validation: uv run pytest -q → 24 passed. M7 confirmation: uv run pytest -q -k 'it10 or no_tools' → 1 passed. IT-10: agent_end event system message sections.tools contains '(none)'. E2e test_e2e_full Phase 6: same assertion passes.
